description: Organisations (CONTRACT §19, spec/KEYLOG.md §2c): ORG_CLAIMED, ORG_REPO_ADDED/REMOVED, DONOR_APPROVED on an o_ id. log: records (logged_at set) replayed in order with signature checks, want = rejection code. A265: an approval or coverage entry issued at or before the claim that set the current owner is a replay (#67–#69). sealable: sealable(device, repo) over the final state (code "" = allowed, then approval_idx). Monitors: me = the owner (device and owner key known); the org takeovers at log #39 and #50 (and the repo moves at #26, #49, #51), and the A265 round trip at #63/#64 alert; with the owner key unknown, every org entry signed by it alerts.
